about: The per-server webhook (registry field webhook) the daemon posts to on a crash, a recovery and a failed auto-restart (a restart that throws, such as the instance having been removed; a restart whose program cannot be spawned writes the spawn-error state and posts nothing) (src/notify.mjs, src/daemon.mjs tell()). A failed post is logged to daemon.log and otherwise ignored; shutdown waits at most 4 s for the last one. test/contracts.test.mjs checks the payload builder and that every message the daemon source writes is listed; test/contracts-daemon.test.mjs captures a real post.

request.url: the webhook field as stored, query string included (Discord's ?wait=true for example)
request.content: **<server name>** — <message> (an em dash, U+2014, with a space each side)

daemonMessages.template: crashed (exit <code or signal>) and is staying down — auto-restart is off.<cause>
daemonMessages.regex: ^crashed \(exit [^)]+\) and is staying down — auto-restart is off\.( Likely cause: .+\.)?$

daemonMessages.template: crashed <n> times in <minutes> minutes; auto-restart gave up. It is staying down until someone looks at it.
daemonMessages.regex: ^crashed \d+ times in \d+ minutes; auto-restart gave up\. It is staying down until someone looks at it\.$

daemonMessages.template: back up after a crash — restart <n> of <limit> allowed per <minutes> minutes.
daemonMessages.regex: ^back up after a crash — restart \d+ of \d+ allowed per \d+ minutes\.$

causeNote: <cause> is " Likely cause: <diagnosis title, lower case>." when src/diagnose.mjs recognises the console tail, else empty; never for a database.
